messages:
alex: FYI found a transitive vuln flagged by dependabot in xml-parser pulled in by aws-sdk-core. GHSA-2026-xxxx. Dependabot suggests patch to 2.4.1. Potential impact: request signing/credential parsing path in runtime container image. Need triage and schedule.
security-bot: Severity: HIGH (CVSS 7.8). Affects images that include aws-sdk-core <=2.3.7. No public exploit reported yet. Link: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2026-xxxx
maya: Does this allow RCE or data exfil? Which customer tiers are exposed (hosted vs dedicated vs private)?
alex: Short answer: no immediate RCE evidence; vector is malformed XML causing credential handling to mis-parse tokens -> could lead to credential leakage in some chaining cases. Affects Dedicated & Private if they use older runtime images. Hosted API has been on patched image since last week (we rolled a prune). Need confirmation from infra on which dedicated pools still running old image.
sanjay: Ops note: inventory shows ~12 dedicated pools on image v2026-02 which include vulnerable deps. Private installs depend on customer-managed images so some may be vulnerable. We can build patched image and push hot swap without restart for most nodes.
rachel: SLA/customer comms: If we need to schedule maintenance for Dedicated customers, they expect 72h notice for non-emergency. This looks urgent but not yet public exploit. Recommend tiered schedule: high-risk tenants (enterprise, PCI) get immediate patch within 48h with notice, others in the 2-week window. Thoughts?
ops-oncall: Canary window proposal: Tue 03:00-07:00 UTC (low traffic NA/EMEA). Can run canary on 2 small pools, then ramp. No expected downtime; image swap can be live. We have one maintenance slot Thu 22:00-02:00 UTC reserved if we need forced restarts for legacy nodes.
maya: Agree with tiered schedule. Also suggest temporary mitigation: add strict XML parsing limiter at proxy to block malformed payloads. That reduces exposure until images are rebuilt.
alex: Good call. I'll open a backport + CI build now, and add a short WAF rule: drop requests with suspicious xml entities. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4321
security-bot: Assigning CVE tracking ticket INFSEC-2026-78. ETA for patch image build: 3h. Recommended rollout: canary -> low -> all dedicated -> private customers via advisory.
sanjay: Logistics: we can flip canary in ~4h, full dedicated sweep in <48h if no regressions. Private installs: prepare advisory + patch bundle; ask SEs to coordinate installs.
rachel: I'll draft customer advisory for enterprise tenants (48h notice), and a general heads-up to private customers with guidance. Include rollback instructions and risk summary.
alex: Plan agreed. Action items: alex create PR & build image, maya add WAF rule, ops-oncall schedule canary, rachel draft comms, sanjay prepare deploy playbook. Follow-up in #eng-security in 6h with progress.
ops-oncall: Noted. If we detect any exploit attempts, escalate to oncall + incident channel. :rotating_light:
alex: thanks all :thumbsup:"
